purpose: Device feasibility and timing only; no validation/test scoring or selected competition model
execution_policy: Sequential fresh processes; later configurations require successful earlier run; no parameter/precision searches
input_scope: Canonical training partition only; deterministic pool and static padding; no held/test predictions
fallback_interpretation: Unsupported-op CPU fallback only considered absent when no fallback warnings and tested path completes with strict mode; ordinary CPU preprocessing/bookkeeping remains allowed
memory_interpretation: Sampled observed maxima; allocated/driver/RSS overlap in unified memory and must not be summed
timing_policy: MPS synchronization around complete optimizer updates; record complete20-update-loop walltime as well; exclude setup/download/tokenization/checkpoint/eval from update benchmark
checkpoints: Benchmark-only numerical/reload checks; not a competition candidate or a warm start for scientific training
